senses.gloss:
याच् याच् (akin to या), i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. To ask, Vikr. d. 41; to solicit, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 1. With the acc. of the object and of the person, Man. 3, 258; also with the abl. of the person, MBh. 1, 6197.
 2. To offer, to tender.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. याचित.
 1. Importuned, Yājñ. 2, 238.
 2. Requisite, necessary, Pañc. 182, 13.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. याचय, To cause to be asked, Pañc. 25, 15; to be invited, Vikr. 37, 8.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To ask, to beg; with two acc., MBh. 3, 10586.
 --With उप उप, उपयाचित,
 1. Requested.
 2. Offered to the deities to render them propitious. n. A vow, Pañc. ii. d. 50; a demand, Kathās. 13, 166.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To beg, to solicit, Chr. 26, 65; with two acc., MBh. 3, 9950.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, The same, 3, 8696.
 --With सम् सम्, The same, 3, 8837.
 --Cf. αἰτέω, and perhaps ζητέω.
याचक याच् + अक, adj. Asking, a beggar, Pañc. ii. d. 110.
याचनक याच् + अन + क, adj. Begging importunately, Man. 3, 165.
याचना याच् + अना, Caus., f. Asking, [] soliciting, Ragh. 11, 78 (Calc. 77, where the Sch. takes it as n.).
याचितक याचित + क (vb. याच्), n. A borrowed thing.
याचिष्णुता याच् + इष्णु + ता, f. Habit of soliciting favours, Man. 12, 33.
याच्ञा याच्ञा, i. e. याच् + न, f. Begging, Hit. i. d. 97, M.M.
